masteries.description: Targets damaged by Mark of Assassin take 8% increased damage for 2 sec

Phase Dash.description: Charges to the front to deal 450% damage to 9 target(s) 2 time(s) and stun them for 2 sec. Movement direction cannot be changed during the dash, and the skill can be used mid-air.

Dark Flare.description: Creates a sword that emanates dark energy for 20 sec to deal 330% damage to 8 nearby target(s) 2 time(s) every 2 sec.

masteries.name: Dark Flare - Strike Interval
masteries.description: Decreases the Dark Flare strike interval by 25%

Venom.description: When attacking, inflicts Venom with a 50% chance. Venom deals continuous damage to the target.

masteries.name: Venom - Weaken
masteries.description: Increases the target's damage taken by 15% for the duration of Venom

Assassinate.description: Attacks the target's vital point with improved action speed to deal damage 2 time(s). The base hit damage increases more with Assassinate skill level. Every time the skill is used 2 times, delivers a powerful finishing blow.

Blood Money.description: When generating Meso with Meso Explosion, creates additional Blood Money branded with an Assassin's Mark with a 50% chance. When using Meso Explosion, attacks nearby targets to deal 3600% damage. The number of targets for this skill is equal to the number of created Blood Money, which stacks up to 5.

masteries.name: Blood Money - Target
masteries.description: Blood Money damage +50% and the number of targets is applied at 2x the Blood Money stack count

masteries.name: Blood Money - Damage
masteries.description: Blood Money damage +50% and the number of targets is applied at 3x the Blood Money stack count

Sea Serpent Burst.description: When attacking with Basic Attack, Sea Serpent's waves always spread to deal 130% additional damage to 5 target(s) in front 2 time(s).

masteries.name: Serpent Scale - Start
masteries.description: [Serpent Scale in Slot] At the start of battle, obtain 5 Serpent Scale(s)

Groggy Mastery.description: Increases Status Effect Damage by 15% and Final Damage by 8%.

masteries.name: Nautilus Strike - Final Attack
masteries.description: [Nautilus Strike in Slot] When attacking, deals 850% additional damage with a 30% chance and a 1-sec cooldown (Damage increases with Nautilus Strike skill level)

Time Leap.description: Instantly decreases the cooldown of Active Skills by 50% and increases Final Damage by 15% for 40 sec. When this skill is in slot, a 12-sec cooldown is applied at the start of battle.

Swift Fire.description: Fires three bullets consecutively ahead to attack up to 8 target(s), dealing 180% damage each.

Scurvy Summons.description: Summons the Dual Pistol Crew of the Nautilus for 20 sec. The Dual Pistol Crew attacks up to 3 nearby target(s) for 95% damage 2 time(s) every 1.5 sec.

Siege Bomber.description: Installs a fixed cannon for 30 sec to deal 190% damage to up to 6 target(s) near the main target every 1.5 sec. Its range is increased by 50% and it can immediately replace itself in auto mode.

masteries.name: Siege Bomber - Setup
masteries.description: Siege Bomber max setup count +1. The first setup after combat starts reduces the cooldown by 15 sec.

Blackboot Bill.description: Fires a giant bullet to deal 170% damage to 9 target(s) in front 4 time(s) and stun them for 2 sec.

All Aboard.description: Summons the Sharpshooter Crew upon using Scurvy Summons. The Sharpshooter Crew fires bullets every 2 sec to deal 110% damage to 8 target(s) near the main target 3 time(s).

Jolly Roger.description: Increases Final Damage by 15% for 18 sec, but decreases Evasion by 5.

masteries.name: Nautilus Strike - Final Attack
masteries.description: [Nautilus Strike in Slot] When attacking, deals 850% additional damage with a 30% chance and a 1-sec cooldown (Damage increases with Nautilus Strike skill level)

Broadside.description: Summons the Nautilus's Battleship. The Battleship arrives behind 3 sec later and deals 5000% damage to 10 nearby target(s) 2 time(s). Afterward, it stays for 30 sec and deals 330% damage to target(s) in front of the Battleship every 2 sec. During auto-combat, the Battleship immediately replaces itself even when already deployed.

masteries.name: Broadside - Bombardment
masteries.description: Broadside's bombardment applies to all attacks and deals 1900% damage to 8 target(s) near the main target 3 time(s)

masteries.name: Broadside - Setup
masteries.description: Broadside max setup count +1. The first setup after combat starts reduces the cooldown by 15 sec.

Rapid Fire.description: Fires bullets at a very high speed 7 time(s) to deal 1800% damage each to up to 9 targets in front.

Majestic Presence.description: When attacking with Basic Attacks, Brain Scrambler, or Rapid Fire, deals 1800% additional damage to up to 6 nearby targets with a 25% chance.
